about: Words the typo audit (tools/typo-audit.mjs) would otherwise flag, each with why it is right as written: a real word one letter-swap from a commoner one, or a slip kept on purpose.

allow.filed: a real word: the codex files a card (the echo chamber's lore), not 'field'
allow.trail: a real word: the stigmergy board's trail, not 'trial'
allow.dose: a real word: the coral skill's heat dose, not 'does'
allow.flies: a real word: 'how far a crow flies', not 'files'
allow.form: a real word: a web form, not 'from'
allow.menaing: kept on purpose: the misspelling from issue #792 that the define skill learned to read (tools/define-typo.test.mjs)
